item.title: Tasktap 1.0.0 — Integrated workspaces
item.description:
A place for the whole task

  • Built-in terminals, tabs, nested splits and media previews.
  • Open and close your own workspaces, with one theme across the app.
  • Clearer task review, preserved source context and readable agent reports.

Existing notes, sessions and terminal preferences are retained. Python 3 is required for terminal sessions. Community build for Apple silicon and macOS 26+, not Apple notarized.
